owner_question: Which account/project/subscription and month range is in scope?
evidence_to_collect: Redacted account/project names and 3-month billing period only
stop_rule: Stop if the scope requires production credentials, secrets or unrestricted console access.

owner_question: Can the review start from exports rather than logins?
evidence_to_collect: CSV/PDF billing export with IDs and customer details removed
stop_rule: No cloud bill, invoice, customer data, personal data, production data, credentials, secrets or API keys should be shared without owner approval.

owner_question: Who owns each top service or workload?
evidence_to_collect: Top-service list mapped to finance and technical owner
stop_rule: Stop if an unowned production system may be changed; assign owner review first.

owner_question: Which candidates are safe to inspect before change?
stop_rule: Do not shut down, resize, delete, change retention or alter commitments without approval gate.

evidence_to_collect: Only state that a readiness review/template exists
stop_rule: Do not claim rankings, demand, leads, customers, revenue, savings, ROI, cost-reduction, outcome or performance results without real evidence.

owner_question: What specialist advice is still needed?
stop_rule: This template is not legal, privacy, security, procurement, tax, financial, architecture or FinOps advice.

owner_question: What is the safe next step before tool/consultant spend?
evidence_to_collect: Fixed-scope no-credentials diagnostic fit check with redacted inputs
stop_rule: Stop if the proposed review asks for production changes before evidence and owner approval.
No real client, customer, cloud account, cloud bill, invoice, production export, testimonial, certification, savings, ROI or cost-reduction proof is included.
